## Purpose

Establish what a lesson is before the foldered form appears.

## Prerequisites

None.

## Learning objectives

- Name the two lesson forms
- Say which one to reach for first

## Theory

A lesson is a Markdown file with frontmatter. The frontmatter carries the id,
the title, the design anchors the lesson needs, and the validators that decide
whether it is finished.

## Concepts to teach

Lesson identity; the slug rule; why the manifest holds the order.

## Constraints

The learner writes no code in this lesson.

## Suggested progression

Read the frontmatter. Explain each field in your own words.

## Completion conditions

The learner states the slug rule without looking at the file.

## On completion, persist

Record nothing.

## Optional deeper paths

None.
